dialogue.en: A: Well, right, let's move to our next order of business, as many of you are aware, in recent weeks there has been a lot of media coverage surrounding this bird flu issue. And it's come to my attention that our company lacks any sort of bird flu contingency plan.

dialogue.en: B: Basically, we need to come up with a clear plan; we need to outline specific actions that our company can take to maintain critical business functions in case a pandemic strikes.
dialogue.zh: B：基本上，我们需要制定一个清晰的计划；我们需要列出公司在疫情爆发时可以采取的具体行动，以维持关键业务运作。

dialogue.en: A: So, what I'd like to do is: first appoint someone to look after drafting our plan; Ralph, I'd like you to head up this project.

dialogue.en: B: Well, let's see, there are a few points we need to be 7 thinking about... first, I'll need you to analyze our numbers and figure out what kind of financial impact an outbreak might have.
